fullContentHtml:
NIC Scientific / Technical Assistant Online Form 2026 – Full Details

National Informatics Centre (NIC) has released the notification for the post of Scientific / Technical Assistant. This recruitment has been issued for 376 posts. The online application process for NIC Scientific / Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 has started from 01 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 30 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NIC Scientific / Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 800/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 00/-
  • Portal Charges Extra Include

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NIC Scientific / Technical Assistant Online Form 2026?

NIC Scientific / Technical Assistant Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
